## Description

Please include a summary of the change, related issues, and context.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactoring or code quality improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Smart contract security / logic update

## Affected Components

- [ ] Smart Contracts (`smart-contracts/`)
- [ ] Backend API (`backend/`)
- [ ] Frontend Application (`frontend/`)
- [ ] DevOps / CI / Tooling (`.github/`, `scripts/`, `docker/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`, `README.md`)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or compilation errors.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit and integration tests pass locally.
